title: Cystic Fibrosis Foundation Patient Registry 2024 Annual Data Report
description: US CF Foundation Patient Registry aggregate statistics for people with CF seen at accredited care centers in 2024 who consented to Registry participation.
notes: Patient-level Registry data are not public. Many complication chapters exclude lung-transplant recipients. 2024 modulator-eligibility charts generally do not treat Alyftrek (approved 20 Dec 2024) as conferring eligibility unless the text says otherwise.

title: Patient Registry landing page
description: Public landing page hosting the Annual Data Report and Highlights PDFs.
notes: Used to confirm the 2024 report is the current public aggregate source.

title: Drug Development Pipeline
description: CFF-classified CF drug development programs including preclinical assets and programs listed as available to patients.
notes: Not an API. The public page can include discontinued programs. Stage labels can lag company updates. Phase 4 will separate active vs discontinued after review.

title: ClinicalTrials.gov Data API v2
description: Public JSON API for registered clinical studies. MVP query is condition cystic fibrosis and interventional study type.
notes: No API key. Sponsor-reported. Misses most preclinical work. filter.studyType is not a valid parameter; use filter.advanced=AREA[StudyType]INTERVENTIONAL.

title: ClinicalTrials.gov Data API documentation
description: Official documentation for the v2 studies endpoint and query parameters.
notes: Used to verify the API before ingest.

organization: U.S. Food and Drug Administration / Vertex
title: TRIKAFTA prescribing information
notes: Initial US approval 2019. Indication language retrieved from the current label.

title: ALYFTREK prescribing information
notes: Initial US approval 2024. CFF reports FDA approval on 20 Dec 2024.

title: openFDA Drugs@FDA API
description: Programmatic access to Drugs@FDA application and product records.
notes: Reserved for later phases. Approval dates in MVP therapies table are taken from labels and CFF reporting unless noted.

title: Search Orphan Drug Designations and Approvals
description: FDA orphan drug designation search with Excel download. No public API.
notes: Designation is not proof of active development. Not ingested in Phase 2.

title: CFTR2 variant resource
description: Public variant-level CFTR information including CF-causing classification and selected clinical correlates.
notes: No public API. Frequencies are not a substitute for CFF US prevalence.

title: PubMed E-utilities
notes: Not used in Phase 2 ingest. Intended for later evidence packs.
